fields.description: A short label for this deployed sage_employee_puller.py instance (e.g. "Payroll Office PC") - purely for people to tell controllers apart, doesn't need to match anything on the host itself.
fields.label: Controller Name

fields.description: The Frappe User this controller authenticates as (its api_key/api_secret belong to this User) - every call it makes is identified against this record by frappe.session.user, so there's no separate controller ID to configure on the host itself.
fields.label: API User

fields.description: Set automatically every time this controller polls for pending pull requests - a stale value here (well beyond its own heartbeat interval) means the host is offline or the script isn't running, not a Frappe-side problem.
fields.label: Last Heartbeat

fields.description: Set automatically after this controller's own data was last successfully ingested into a Sage Payroll Run.
fields.label: Last Sync

fields.description: Which Sage Company Numbers this controller is allowed to pull, and the local ODBC DSN it uses for each - fetched by the controller itself on every heartbeat cycle (get_remote_controller_config) instead of living in a local JSON config file on the host.
fields.label: Companies Served
